openQuestions: Quality efficacy versus the deterministic baseline still requires a fixed-corpus comparison and human evidence.

resolvedQuestions.question: Why do rewrites underwhelm at the representation boundary?
resolvedQuestions.answer: The dialect tokenizes every protected range into an opaque ~48-char marker, the wire body is a two-message prompt, and the instruction asks the model to preserve facts/names/numbers/paths it can no longer see; the validator also accepts an unchanged echo via the restored.text === sourceText short-circuit.

resolvedQuestions.question: Which quality levers are wired versus gated fail-closed?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Temperature and thinking controls are gated fail-closed for the shipped DeepSeek preset (capabilities 'unknown'), so the reference-like profile returns exact-original before transport; the profile has no few-shot/token-rubric field; adjacent spans are not coalesced; no source-backed model quality tier exists.

resolvedQuestions.question: Is the meaning-preservation judge wired into the provider/runtime/render path?
resolvedQuestions.answer: No: executeProviderRoute returns a candidate and decideRender consumes a validation result, neither invoking the judge; evaluateFidelityVeto hard-disables it; the judge sees restored plaintext (a second egress if hosted); the offline proxy reviewer is provisional evidence, not a runtime validator.

resolvedQuestions.question: Is local-tokenize -> model -> restore the right architecture?
resolvedQuestions.answer: The primitive is the right security boundary but whole-message projection is the wrong granularity; the payload is raw text and the Codex adapter references canonical text IDs, so a hybrid deterministic skeleton plus bounded prose slots is the best fit; semantic diff is a safety gate, not a renderer; Codex is the only full-projection path.

resolvedQuestions.question: Does projection earn its complexity over deterministic formatting?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Conditionally: complex multi-sentence user-facing warnings, caveats, consequences, and recovery explanations justify a deterministic-first hybrid; short/structured messages stay deterministic/native; release requires human non-inferiority; rollback makes the safe-native experiment reversible.

keyFindings.title: Protection covers structure, not just values
keyFindings.summary: collectProtectedRanges protects fenced code, tables, headings, commands, list markers, links, URLs, paths, quoted literals, variables, flags, hashes, identifiers, and numbers; accepted ranges are only overlap-filtered, never merged.

keyFindings.title: Every span becomes a ~48-char opaque placeholder
keyFindings.summary: createToken emits ⟦pcp:v1:{24-hex-namespace}:{index}:{12-hex-digest}⟧ with no readable semantics; the model must reproduce each exactly once in order.

keyFindings.title: Wire body is one system + one user message
keyFindings.summary: messages() sends systemInstruction plus the whole encoded text; no token inventory, schema, or examples.

keyFindings.title: Prompt describes values the model cannot see
keyFindings.summary: The instruction says 'keep every fact, name, number, and file path', but those values are already opaque ⟦pcp:v1:...⟧ tokens; the model is never told how to treat the placeholders.

keyFindings.title: Unchanged echo is accepted without quality check
keyFindings.summary: The Markdown-structure and semantic-veto stages run only inside if (restored.text !== sourceText), so a verbatim echo skips every readability/meaning check and is accepted.

keyFindings.title: Restoration is fail-closed on any token deviation
keyFindings.summary: duplicate, changed, unexpected, missing, or reordered tokens all reject; token granularity therefore trades directly against model usability.

keyFindings.title: DeepSeek temperature/thinking gated fail-closed
keyFindings.summary: baseCapabilities(true) marks temperature/thinking 'unknown'; compilePromptControls requires state 'yes' + confidence 'confirmed', so the shipped preset + reference-like profile returns unsupported('temperature') and exact-original before transport.

keyFindings.title: Prompt profile has no few-shot/rubric field
keyFindings.summary: PromptProfileRecord has promptVersion, systemInstruction, copyEditingScope, protectedValuePolicyVersion, temperature, thinkingMode, providerControlMappings, unsupportedControlBehavior — no examples or token contract.

keyFindings.title: Adjacent spans are not coalesced
keyFindings.summary: addRange only overlap-filters; each inline regex emits its own token, so a flag + number + path in one clause become three ~48-char tokens with no adjacent-span context.

keyFindings.title: Live smoke is not reproducible through shipped preset
keyFindings.summary: The smoke's modest rewrite implies fresh confirmed capability evidence (or a distinct profile) that is not checked into the package; the exact-original short-circuit otherwise fires first.

keyFindings.title: Optional meaning judge is not composed into rendering
keyFindings.summary: executeProviderRoute returns a candidate, decideRender consumes a validation result; no production source connects the candidate to validateProjectionCandidate with judgeMode required.

keyFindings.title: Evaluation fidelity veto disables the judge
keyFindings.summary: evaluateFidelityVeto calls validateProjectionCandidate with judgeMode 'disabled', so the deterministic evaluation lane never exercises the meaning judge.

keyFindings.title: Judge seam receives restored plaintext values
keyFindings.summary: runJudge passes sourceText (decoded) and restored.text (restored candidate), so a hosted judge would be a second egress of real protected values.

keyFindings.title: Semantic veto operates on restored text
keyFindings.summary: compareSemanticMeaning runs after restoration, so protected numbers/identifiers are already guaranteed; the veto can only catch prose-level drift, never awkwardness, verbosity, or a barely-changed rewrite.

keyFindings.title: Offline proxy reviewer is provisional evidence
keyFindings.summary: scoreMaskedReviewPacketWithProxy returns evidenceClass 'llm-proxy'; assertHumanCertifiable throws on proxy evidence, so it can rank profiles/models but never authorize a release.

keyFindings.title: Projection payload is raw text, not typed fields
keyFindings.summary: completeAssembly decodes the final assistant message's exact bytes to text; EventEnvelope.payload is an opaque JsonObject and the Codex adapter maps content to canonical references (textOriginalId, toolInputOriginalId, toolResultOriginalId).

keyFindings.title: Typed event envelope supports a deterministic shell
keyFindings.summary: EventEnvelope carries typed kind, phase, terminalStatus, order coordinates, and canonical refs, so a deterministic renderer can format the shell of typed status/error/lifecycle messages without a model.

keyFindings.title: Hybrid skeleton + prose slots fits the boundaries
keyFindings.summary: A deterministic skeleton for the structured shell plus bounded locally-protected prose slots for raw-text regions concentrates model work where it helps and reduces opaque-token burden; the primitive stays as the security boundary.

keyFindings.title: Codex is the only full-projection path
keyFindings.summary: CodexCapabilityRecords marks completeMessage and atomicRenderDecision CONFIRMED_YES but append and sidecar CONFIRMED_NO; full-projection parity requires ownsCompleteMessage && ownsAtomicRenderDecision.

keyFindings.title: Deterministic formatting should own short and structured messages
keyFindings.summary: Short statuses, typed lifecycle events, command/result summaries, raw tool data, secret-heavy diagnostics, and incomplete streams have little incremental readability value from a model and should default to native/deterministic or exact-original.

keyFindings.title: Release requires human non-inferiority evidence
keyFindings.summary: Runbook step 8 requires a powered, blinded HUMAN non-inferiority study; proxy/synthetic scores are diagnostic only and assertHumanCertifiable throws on llm-proxy evidence.

keyFindings.title: Provider-free rollback makes safe-native rollout reversible
keyFindings.summary: Rollback disables projections, selects OriginalOnlyEmergencyMode, reinstalls the previous exact tarball offline, and verifies the canonical transcript digest — no provider call, no canonical mutation.

keyFindings.title: Durable content is out of scope
keyFindings.summary: The skill's WHEN NOT TO USE excludes rewriting durable Markdown or on-disk files; value is bounded to transient display of a terminal message.

ruledOutDirections.reason: Exact ordered restoration is the fail-closed privacy/fidelity boundary.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Treat the two-message wire body as a sufficient prompt
ruledOutDirections.reason: It carries no token contract or examples.
Temperature cannot be applied through the shipped DeepSeek preset without fresh confirmed capability evidence.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Assume a model-tier upgrade is source-confirmed
ruledOutDirections.reason: No package source establishes a quality ranking across tiers.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Use the masked LLM proxy reviewer as the runtime meaning gate
ruledOutDirections.reason: It is comparative provisional evidence, not a privacy-scoped reject-only validator.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Call a hosted judge after restoration
ruledOutDirections.reason: It would egress restored plaintext values as a second boundary.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Replace local restoration with remote structured rendering
ruledOutDirections.reason: It moves exactness/privacy across the provider boundary without solving arbitrary assistant prose.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Assume event kind alone supports universal templates
ruledOutDirections.reason: The projected body is raw text, not typed fields.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Use semantic diff as a readability generator
ruledOutDirections.reason: It is a deterministic rejection/diagnostic layer.
Short/structured output has little incremental value while each model route adds latency, provider, validation, and fallback cost.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Use hosted routing as a default quality upgrade
ruledOutDirections.reason: It requires consent and fresh privacy evidence, with no source-backed provider/tier winner.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Treat proxy/synthetic/injected evidence as product-value proof
ruledOutDirections.reason: Release requires a powered blinded human non-inferiority study.

nextFocus: No further loop; future work is the fixed-corpus quality and human non-inferiority validation described in research.md.
